# Which items on your menu are Stars, Plowhorses, Puzzles and Dogs?

> Free tool for restaurant owners: drop in your POS item-sales export and see every menu item as a Star, Plowhorse, Puzzle or Dog, the dollar impact of a price rise on Plowhorses, and what to cut or re-promote. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
